text:
Situation: Tirzepatide 2.5 mg/0.5 mL syringes are in shortage at Corvale East with 43 units on hand, covering 10.3 days at the current daily use of 4.2 syringes.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows tirzepatide has been listed since 2022-12-15 and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on the list for 46 months. The product label identifies Eli Lilly and Company as the manufacturer. There is no public FDA signal at our plants for this drug.

Our position: Current inventory is insufficient to sustain routine dispensing beyond 10 days. No replenishment timeline has been confirmed by the manufacturer. Allocation protocols must be activated immediately to prioritize existing patients.

Recommended actions:
1. Activate allocation protocol limiting dispensing to current maintenance patients; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Contact Eli Lilly and Company medical affairs for allocation increase and estimated resupply dates; requires Buyer lead.
3. Submit therapeutic interchange criteria for committee review to guide prescriber transitions if supply exhausts; requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Report inventory status daily to Health System Supply Chain Command Center; requires Operations Manager approval.

Not recommended: Initiating new patient starts with current inventory; purchasing from unverified secondary distributors; compounding alternatives without sterility validation.
